title: Inject Skill executor registry through production M8 composition
goal: Allow production composition to receive an explicitly registered SkillExecutorRegistry and prove the M8 runtime uses it for an installed Skill.
context: M8CompositionRoot currently creates SkillRuntime with the default empty registry, so custom executors cannot be supplied through the production composition API. Skill.md executor names remain declarative and do not instantiate code; callers must explicitly register trusted executors.
forbidden_changes: Do not instantiate executors from arbitrary Skill.md metadata.
Do not bypass policy, verification, cancellation, module capability, or schema checks.
Do not modify App/ or Xcode project files.
Do not silently grant new capabilities to installed Skills.
acceptance_criteria: M8CompositionRoot initializer accepts an injectable SkillExecutorRegistry with a source-compatible default.
M8 passes the exact injected registry into SkillRuntime.
A production-root regression test loads a custom Skill.md and proves an explicitly registered executor can execute and verify it.
An arbitrary executor name without registry registration remains non-executable.
verification: Confirm Swift package tests + repository integrity, macOS Xcode iOS arm64 build/unsigned IPA, and validate-contract CI gates.
recovery: Revert this single logical commit if M8 source compatibility or Skill fail-closed behavior regresses.
